title: The 6dh status model fixture now has a second reader: move it into the pinned contract bundle
body:
cloudflare/src/status.ts is the TypeScript reader of ticfac.status.v1 that 6dh's own note said would come with the phone page, and its shape is still pinned only by the Go-side fixture internal/statusmodel/contract.json. Two readers of one contract with the fixture on one side is exactly the drift the bundle exists to prevent — the TS reader re-declares a subset and refuses unknown schema versions, so a model change lands green on both suites while the phone page silently degrades. Move the fixture into the pinned bundle and point both readers at it.
folded target: pengelbrecht/ticks (contracts bundle)
